options: Reducing the number of rows returned by a query
Converting details into a summarised format
Converting data into a single standard format
questions.explanation: Data Aggregation is about converting details into a summarised format, such as answering 'twelve' rather than naming every month.

questions.stem: Which everyday example illustrates Data Aggregation in *I Am Datapedia!*?
options: Answering 'there are 12 months' instead of naming every month of the year
Checking the country a product was made in
Moving a desktop to another office
questions.explanation: When asked how many months are in a year, you answer 'twelve' rather than listing them all, which is aggregation.

questions.stem: In the installations example, what would you send your manager instead of the detailed list?
options: A list of every device serial number
A summarised report showing 6 iOS and 3 Android installations
A geocoded map of every installation
questions.explanation: Rather than the detailed list, you send the summarised report: in total 6 iOS and 3 Android installations.

questions.stem: Which aggregation functions are listed as ISO standard?
options: DISTINCT, GROUP BY, ORDER BY, WHERE, JOIN
questions.explanation: COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN and MAX are the aggregation functions listed as per ISO standards.

questions.stem: Which of the following is listed among the other, non-ISO aggregation functions?
questions.explanation: STRING_AGG appears in the list of other aggregation functions, alongside APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT, CHECKSUM_AGG, COUNT_BIG, GROUPING, STDEV and VAR.

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT named as an aggregation function?
questions.explanation: APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT, CHECKSUM_AGG, COUNT_BIG and GROUPING_ID are all listed aggregation functions; SUBSTRING is not.

questions.stem: Where are aggregation functions normally used, according to *I Am Datapedia!*?
options: In databases or data stores, to summarise stored data
questions.explanation: Because data is normally stored in databases or data stores, aggregation functions are used there to summarise the data.

questions.stem: How widely is Data Aggregation used, according to the author?
options: Everywhere in daily life, whether in the office or at home
questions.explanation: Data Aggregation is described as the most used term in daily life, used everywhere whether in the office or at home.

questions.stem: Which pair of functions both belong to the list of other aggregation functions concerned with variance and standard deviation?
questions.explanation: STDEV, STDEVP, VAR and VARP appear among the other aggregation functions.

questions.stem: Which function computes the average and is listed as an ISO standard aggregation function?
questions.explanation: AVG is the ISO standard aggregation function listed for averages.
